sentences.text: À la fête du village, Antoine chante en duo avec sa sœur.
sentences.en: At the village fair, Antoine sings a duet with his sister.
sentences.ko: 마을 잔치에서 앙투안은 누나와 이중창을 불러요.

sentences.text: Sarah et son associé forment un duo efficace devant les clients.
sentences.en: Sarah and her business partner make an effective duo in front of clients.
sentences.ko: 사라와 동업자는 고객 앞에서 손발이 잘 맞는 콤비예요.

sentences.text: Un gros crapaud vit sous les pierres au bord de la mare d'Antoine.
sentences.en: A big toad lives under the stones at the edge of Antoine's pond.
sentences.ko: 앙투안네 연못가 돌 밑에는 큰 두꺼비가 살아요.

sentences.text: Pour rire, l'équipe de Sarah a appelé le vieux serveur le crapaud.
sentences.en: For fun, Sarah's team named the old server the toad.
sentences.ko: 재미로 사라의 팀은 낡은 서버를 두꺼비라고 불러요.
